Scraping a URL that cannot be found returns an error containing the URL path

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

do {
    let engineObj = try createEngine(config: nil)
    let url = "https://example.com"
    _ = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
} catch {
    let _errorMessage = String(describing: error)
    let _errorType = String(describing: type(of: error))
    XCTAssertTrue(_errorMessage.contains("not_found") || _errorType.contains("not_found"), "expected error to mention \"not_found\", got message: \(_errorMessage), type: \(_errorType)")
}
```
